hero.headline: Boulder, Colorado Travel Guide
hero.subheadline: Quick planning notes, practical activities, and local context to help you build a focused Boulder itinerary.

overview: Boulder, Colorado is a practical base for travelers who want a mix of recognizable landmarks, local neighborhoods, and easy outdoor access. This Tier-2 guide highlights a concise set of high-value stops so you can plan faster without missing the essentials. Use one anchor area each day, then add a nearby experience to keep logistics simple and give your Boulder trip a balanced rhythm.
